description: This file defines an abstract test runner class for transaction attribution tests in Orleans. It includes multiple test methods to verify transaction context behaviors with different attribute configurations in a distributed transactional system.

classes.name: TransactionAttributionTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing a test framework for Orleans transaction attribution scenarios, with shared setup and test methods.

methods.name: AllSupportedAttributesFromOutsideTransactionTest
methods.description: Verifies transaction contexts when calling with various attributes from outside a transaction.

methods.name: AllSupportedAttributesFromWithinTransactionTest
methods.description: Verifies transaction contexts when calling with various attributes from within a transaction.

methods.name: CreateOrJoinTest
methods.description: Tests the behavior of CreateOrJoin transaction attribution option.

methods.name: CreateTest
methods.description: Tests the behavior of Create transaction attribution option.

methods.name: SupportedTest
methods.description: Ensures that 'Supported' attributed calls correctly join existing transactions.

methods.name: JoinFailTest
methods.description: Checks that attempting to join in unsupported contexts throws an exception.

methods.name: NotAllowedFailTest
methods.description: Verifies that usage of 'NotAllowed' attribute results in the correct exception.
